extracted.intended_audience: Participants in National Novel Writing Month / aspiring novelists seeking motivation during NaNoWriMo
extracted.subtask_description: Description and archive page for NaNoWriMo 'pep talks' — short inspirational letters from established authors delivered during National Novel Writing Month to motivate participants to keep writing. Includes lists of contributors and links to individual pep talks by year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition / purpose of Pep Talks
rubrics_metrics.description: Pep talks are inspirational letters written by well-known authors during NaNoWriMo just for you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: They’ll be delivered to your NaNoMail inbox throughout NaNoWriMo season, ready to inspire you, motivate you, and keep you writing all month long.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorship / contributor expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Pep talk veterans include folks like Aimee Bender, Dave Eggers, John Green, Neil Gaiman, Jonathan Lethem, Lois Lowry, Karen Russell, and Lemony Snicket.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists many well-known authors by name (e.g., Jenny Han, Maggie Stiefvater, Alexander Chee, Daniel José Older, Gene Luen Yang, Diana Gabaldon, etc.), implying pep talks are typically written by established or notable authors to lend credibility and resonance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delivery timing and archival practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Pep talks are delivered throughout NaNoWriMo season via NaNoMail and are organized/archived by year on the site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site context indicates NaNoWriMo runs November 1-30; pep talks are provided during that season and older pep talks are kept in a Pep Talk Archive (authors grouped by year).
